info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete P2m By Terminal Id-spec
info.description: The Terminal Management API provides capabilities for managing terminal resources within the P2m microservice. This endpoint allows users to remove a terminal identified by its unique terminal ID, streamlining inventory control and resource allocation. Common use cases include decommissioning outdated terminals or updating the terminal roster when business operations change. This API is typically employed by system administrators and operational teams responsible for maintaining terminal infrastructure.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to remove a terminal identified by its unique ID. Make sure that you have the necessary permissions to delete the terminal before making this request.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a terminal resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary information to confirm the deletion.

204.description: Successfully deleted the resource and returned no content.
